T: Believe in Santa. Believe in dinner.
D: A department store Santa claims he is the real thing, and a court case decides it.
P: Serve the snacks when Kris signs with a deaf girl.
S: Apple, celery, grapes and toasted walnuts in lemon mayo on crisp cos leaves

The old New York hotel salad, the kind of lunch Dorey Walker eats at her desk while the parade comes together. Toast 80g walnuts and chop roughly. Mix 100g mayonnaise, 100g Greek yoghurt, the juice of half a lemon, salt and pepper. Dice 3 crisp red apples and toss in the rest of the lemon juice. Slice 4 celery stalks and halve 150g red grapes. Fold everything through the dressing with most of the walnuts. Pile onto cos leaves and finish with the last walnuts and snipped chives.
M: Herb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing

Herb-butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing, creamy mash, gravy and a bright cranberry orange relish. Push 60g herb butter under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Crumble 300g cornbread with 1 fried onion, 2 celery sticks, 2 tbsp sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Simmer 150g cranberry sauce with orange zest. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: New York pumpkin pie with maple cream
Pumpkin pie in a crisp crust, served with maple cream

Silky spiced pumpkin pie in a crisp pastry shell, topped with maple whipped cream and toasted pecans. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and bake blind at 190C for 12 minutes. Steam 600g peeled pumpkin until soft, drain well and mash smooth. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml cream, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger and a pinch of nutmeg. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool. Whip 200ml cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup and serve with toasted pecans.
In God We Trust gingerbread cookies
Ginger and cinnamon gingerbread with golden syrup

Soft spiced gingerbread cut into Santas, stars and toy soldiers, iced in white and red, the treats handed out in Santa's line. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut out shapes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 200g icing sugar with 2 tbsp water, tint a third red, and pipe on outlines and details.
K: Hot apple cider with maple, cinnamon, clove and orange

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise, orange and a little maple, served steaming with a cinnamon stick. Pour 1.2L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 tbsp maple syrup, 4 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling so the spices infuse. Strain into 4 mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.

dishes.make_ahead: Toast the walnuts and mix the dressing up to 2 days ahead; dice the apple and dress the salad up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan and chop roughly.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, juice of half the lemon, salt and pepper.
Dice the apples and toss in the rest of the lemon juice. Slice the celery and halve the grapes.
Fold everything through the dressing with most of the walnuts.
Pile onto cos leaves and finish with the last walnuts and snipped chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the herb butter and the cranberry sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep them chilled; roast the turkey and make the gravy on the day

steps.text: Mash some butter with sage and push it under the skin of the turkey.
Roast at 180C.
Fry the onion and celery, crumble in the cornbread and mix with sage, egg and some stock. Bake in a dish for the last part of the roasting.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange zest.
Rest the turkey and make gravy from the juices with the flour and remaining stock.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sage butter up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkin, halved lengthways and seeded

steps.text: Mash 60 g of the butter with half the sage and rub it over the cut side of the pumpkin.
Roast cut side up at 180C until tender and golden.
Fry the onion and celery in a little butter, crumble in the cornbread and mix with the rest of the sage, the egg and 150 ml of the stock. Bake in a dish for the last 30 minutes of roasting.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange zest.
Melt the last of the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the remaining stock and the pumpkin tray juices and simmer into gravy.

dishes.n: In God We Trust gingerbread cookies
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 5 days, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Melt the butter with the golden syrup and sugar. Mix in the flour, ground ginger, ground cinnamon and egg to a dough.
Chill the dough.
Roll out thin and cut shapes.
Bake at 180C, then cool.
Mix the icing sugar with water, tint a third red and pipe on outlines and details.

dishes.n: New York pumpkin pie with maple cream

steps.text: Line a 23cm pie dish with the pastry and bake blind at 190C.
Steam the pumpkin until soft, drain well and mash smooth.
Beat the pumpkin with the sugar, eggs, some of the cream, the cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg. Pour into the case.
Bake at 170C until just set.
Cool the pie.
Whip the remaining cream with the maple syrup and serve with toasted pecans.

dishes.make_ahead: Steep the spices in the juice up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled, then reheat gently; strain and serve hot

ingredients.item: cinnamon sticks (4 to simmer, 4 to serve)

steps.text: Pour the apple juice into a saucepan with the maple syrup, half the cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange.
Heat gently without boiling so the spices infuse.
Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.
